svg.text: Tern GT on ridgeline_circuit: cold tires on the first lap from the pits
Left: the thermal model's factors at a uniform tire temperature; the dashed boxes are a published cold-to-hot change (Singh and Sivaramakrishnan, arXiv:2305.18422).
Right: the first lap from the pits with the tires at 20 °C (solid) and at 45 °C (dotted); grip is the mean of the four tires' factors.
Grip and stiffness factor against temperature
First lap from the pits: temperatures (°C, left axis) and grip
grip factor (0.90 at the bottom to 1.00 at the top)
